AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator registry entry for elevated RBAC permissions.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

grantedBy.description: UID of the administrator who granted this role.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin record was last updated.

StaffPublicProfile.title: StaffPublicProfile
StaffPublicProfile.description: Non-PII staff profile for Big Tree Outdoor lighting inspection personnel.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the staff member.

displayName.description: Display name of the staff member.

staffRole.description: Operational role in the lighting inspection team.

assignedInspectorName.description: Mapped roster inspector name (Nusir, Yana, Fadrul, Asyaqif, Ray, or All).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

StaffPrivateInfo.title: StaffPrivateInfo
StaffPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII record for a staff member, accessible only by the owner or admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the staff member.

email.description: Verified corporate or Google email address of the staff member.

lastLoginLabel.description: Formatted timestamp string of most recent staff sign-in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was last updated.

InspectionPeriod.title: InspectionPeriod
InspectionPeriod.description: Monthly lighting inspection schedule, site checklists, and zone statuses for Big Tree Outdoor.

periodId.description: Deterministic period identifier in YEAR_MONTH format (e.g., 2026_8).

zoneCount.description: Number of zones in this inspection period (1-50).

zones.description: Bounded array of up to 50 ZoneData objects containing site statuses and checklist records.

createdBy.description: UID of the staff member who initialized this period document.

updatedBy.description: UID of the staff member who last updated this period document.

updatedByName.description: Display name of the staff member who last updated this period document.

lastAction.description: Summary of the most recent update action performed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the period document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the period document was last updated.

/staff_private/{userId}.description: Isolated PII records for staff members, accessible only by owner or admin.

/periods/{periodId}.description: Monthly lighting inspection data for all zones and billboard sites.
